parts.name: hull_top
parts.note: Clamshell upper half with the integral tail end wall: skin; the dorsal groove where the righting leg lies flush (its floor is the leg's fold stop), the knuckle (a 0.6 mm blister over the leg N20's worm box), two side pockets for the leg's cheeks, the couplers' bores through the knuckle walls and the outer walls, the flute forward of the hinge (far rest 179.5 deg), the arch recess for the pad on the tail top; two faired pivot blocks (pod coupler bores; their carved faces are the deploy and fold stops); tight bores for the drill leads; the XIAO USB-C notch (open to the split, so the half drops straight on); upper halves of the two flank socket seats; the upper half of the tail key slot in the end wall. The seam is a butt joint: deck 1's edges in the seam groove, the nose spigot and the tray's tail key in the end-wall slot align the halves. Radial M3 clearance at z +3 into the bosses on disc 1 and the rear disc
parts.orient: split face down (on the bed), crown up

parts.name: hull_bottom
parts.note: Clamshell lower half with the integral tail end wall: plain Ø42 belly (launcher cradle surface; the cells rest on it, located by the tray's U saddles), lower halves of the pivot blocks' skirts, of the two flank socket seats and of the tail key slot; the two Ø2.0 tether tie holes in the end wall (line in one, out the other, tied to itself; inside the launcher pusher's Ø14 hole). Radial M3 clearance at z -3 into the bosses on disc 1 and the rear disc

parts.name: nose
parts.note: Blunt hollow nose: Ø22 flat tip with the Ø9.8 lens hole, Caddx Ant pocket 14.4 x 15.0 (slides in from the back, 1.2 lip + lens recess hold it; 2.2 below the axis), 1.5 walls; the BALLAST POCKET: the lower part of the hollow round the camera tube from the front of the hollow back to a retaining collar at x 13.2, filled with 14.6 g of putty from the back (through the spigot) before the nose goes on; the forward end of the dorsal flute where the righting leg lies at its far rest (solid under it, 1.2 over the camera tube); spigot with a groove that the hull rib locks when the clamshell closes
parts.orient: tip down on the bed (flat Ø22), spigot up

parts.name: tray
parts.note: One-piece spine: deck 1 nose to tail right over the two cells (its edges sit in the hull's seam groove, backing the split seam; at the tail it continues as a key into the slots in both end walls), disc 1 and the rear disc with a solid 6 mm boss at each of the 8 radial M3 screws, the leg N20 cradle at the front (motor pointing down) with two tongues that close the stub slots, four U cell saddles (open 19.2 at the bottom, the cells slide in), deck 2 for the VTX and the MP1584, the deploy N20 cradle at the rear (motor pointing down) with the two DRV8833 standing beside it, a tab under the XIAO USB-C that fills the hull top's notch; contact recesses (springs front, BM strip between the cells, plates rear)
parts.orient: flat underside (z -16: saddle feet, disc bottoms, cradle tubes) on the bed; deck 1 bridges between the saddles and discs, deck 2 between its walls (enable thick bridges)

parts.name: righting_leg
parts.note: Righting leg (PLA): a slim blade 8.5 wide whose top is the hull crown (flush in the dorsal groove), an arch pad that is a patch of the hull skin on the tail top (37 wide), and a fork root: two round cheeks on the two Ø6 couplers in the side pockets, tines curving aft into a bridge that swings over the knuckle. Swing 0 to 178 deg over the nose (far rest 179.5); hinge 33 from the nose tip, pad centre 113 from the hinge. Each cheek is a press fit (D bore 6.05) on its coupler, a drop of CA
parts.orient: upside down (the blade crown on the bed, cheeks up), brim 5 mm (the crown touches the bed along a 5 mm strip only), tree supports under the ends of the pad arch

parts.name: leg_coupler_L
parts.note: Ø6 D coupler (PPA-CF): pressed in from outside through the plug counterbore, the cheek (press fit, CA) and the knuckle wall bore onto the leg N20's trimmed stub (press-fit D socket Ø3.05, flat at 1.03, CA): no play between the motor and the leg; it runs in the knuckle wall bore and in the skin plug's blind bore, so the hull carries the leg; the plug and the worm box hold it axially
parts.orient: lying on its D flat, PPA-CF

parts.name: leg_coupler_R
parts.note: Ø6 D coupler (PPA-CF): pressed in from outside through the plug counterbore, the cheek (press fit, CA) and the knuckle wall bore onto the leg N20's trimmed stub (press-fit D socket Ø3.05, flat at 1.03, CA): no play between the motor and the leg; it runs in the knuckle wall bore and in the skin plug's blind bore, so the hull carries the leg; the plug and the worm box hold it axially
parts.orient: lying on its D flat, PPA-CF

parts.name: leg_plug_L
parts.note: Skin plug Ø7.5 (PLA): pressed flush into the counterbore over the leg coupler (a drop of CA); its blind bore is the coupler's outer bearing and holds it in. Pry it out to pull the coupler for service
parts.orient: outer face up (a domed button), no supports

parts.name: leg_plug_R
parts.note: Skin plug Ø7.5 (PLA): pressed flush into the counterbore over the leg coupler (a drop of CA); its blind bore is the coupler's outer bearing and holds it in. Pry it out to pull the coupler for service
parts.orient: outer face up (a domed button), no supports

parts.name: drill_leg_L
parts.note: Drill arm (rear pod, folds forward): round head pressed on the Ø7 D coupler (flat rear face = stop face on the hull's pivot block), spare eye lug on the head's outboard 5 mm (Ø3.2, 6.8 below the pivot; not used: the tether ties to the tail), short neck with the motor-lead channel, thrust shoulder for the auger hub, stationary bushing Ø15.8 that holds the drill gearmotor by its can
parts.orient: standing on the head's flat rear face (stop face) down, no supports

parts.name: drill_leg_L_auger
parts.note: Tapered drill auger, right-hand: Ø18.7 hub round the stationary motor (runs on the arm's bushing, base face on the arm shoulder), gimlet core Ø9.6 -> Ø6, anchor flight Ø16 pitch 12 (load face toward the motor 45 deg), point 14; the motor's M3 shaft is its spine (nut A pressed in the hub, self-tapped bore)
parts.orient: standing on its base (point up), brim 5 mm

parts.name: drill_leg_L_motor
parts.note: Drill gearmotor 12 x 10, gearbox 11.95, 24.27 face to back (measured): fixed in the arm, inside the auger hub

parts.name: drill_leg_L_shaft
parts.note: M3 threaded motor shaft Ø2.84 x 56.03 (measured): the auger's steel spine

parts.name: drill_leg_L_nut
parts.note: M3 nut A pressed into the hex pocket at the end of the hub bore

parts.name: drill_leg_R
parts.note: Drill arm (rear pod, folds forward): round head pressed on the Ø7 D coupler (flat rear face = stop face on the hull's pivot block), spare eye lug on the head's outboard 5 mm (Ø3.2, 6.8 below the pivot; not used: the tether ties to the tail), short neck with the motor-lead channel, thrust shoulder for the auger hub, stationary bushing Ø15.8 that holds the drill gearmotor by its can
parts.orient: standing on the head's flat rear face (stop face) down, no supports

parts.name: drill_leg_R_auger
parts.note: Tapered drill auger, left-hand: Ø18.7 hub round the stationary motor (runs on the arm's bushing, base face on the arm shoulder), gimlet core Ø9.6 -> Ø6, anchor flight Ø16 pitch 12 (load face toward the motor 45 deg), point 14; the motor's M3 shaft is its spine (nut A pressed in the hub, self-tapped bore)
parts.orient: standing on its base (point up), brim 5 mm

parts.name: drill_leg_R_motor
parts.note: Drill gearmotor 12 x 10, gearbox 11.95, 24.27 face to back (measured): fixed in the arm, inside the auger hub

parts.name: drill_leg_R_shaft
parts.note: M3 threaded motor shaft Ø2.84 x 56.03 (measured): the auger's steel spine

parts.name: drill_leg_R_nut
parts.note: M3 nut A pressed into the hex pocket at the end of the hub bore

parts.name: coupler_L
parts.note: Ø7 D coupler (PPA-CF): press-fit D socket (Ø3.05, flat at 1.03, CA) on the deploy N20 stub, runs in the pivot block bore (the hull carries the pod), press fit into the arm head's D bore (7.05, CA): the axle is stiff, so both pods load the one worm together; the printed pod cap and an M3 x 8 screw seat on its outer end
parts.orient: lying on its D flat (layers along the axle), PPA-CF

parts.name: coupler_R
parts.note: Ø7 D coupler (PPA-CF): press-fit D socket (Ø3.05, flat at 1.03, CA) on the deploy N20 stub, runs in the pivot block bore (the hull carries the pod), press fit into the arm head's D bore (7.05, CA): the axle is stiff, so both pods load the one worm together; the printed pod cap and an M3 x 8 screw seat on its outer end
parts.orient: lying on its D flat (layers along the axle), PPA-CF

parts.name: cell_1
parts.note: 18350 Ø18.66 x 36.87 incl. button (measured); the two in line on the keel, button aft (front spring B-, BM strip between, rear plate B+)

parts.name: cell_2
parts.note: 18350 Ø18.66 x 36.87 incl. button (measured); the two in line on the keel, button aft (front spring B-, BM strip between, rear plate B+)

parts.name: n20_leg
parts.note: LEG worm N20 (the old kick motor), motor pointing down in the tray cradle, worm box in the knuckle under the 0.6 mm blister; output shaft = the leg hinge, both stubs trimmed to 5.8 mm past the box (|y| 10.8), driving the two couplers

parts.name: leg_shaft
parts.note: leg N20 output shaft (turns with the leg), stubs trimmed to |y| 10.8

parts.name: n20_deploy
parts.note: DEPLOY worm N20 on the pod axle, motor pointing down in the tray's rear cradle (low CG)

parts.name: deploy_shaft
parts.note: deploy N20 output shaft (turns with the couplers), both stubs in the couplers

parts.name: xiao
parts.note: xiao 17.74 x 21.45 board (+1.3 USB-C lip), 4.49 thick (measured); USB-C to the right flank window

parts.name: ina219
parts.note: ina219 25.69 x 20.32 x 4.70 (measured)

parts.name: bno085
parts.note: bno085 22.77 x 25.72 x 4.77 (measured)

parts.name: vtx
parts.note: vtx 42.25 x 19.91 x 6.01 (measured)

parts.name: bms_2s
parts.note: bms_2s 40.80 x 8.00 x 2.10 (measured)

parts.name: camera
parts.note: Caddx Ant 13.99 x 14.59, 18.34 front to back (measured), 2.2 below the axis

parts.name: screws_radial
parts.note: 8 x M3 x 8 countersunk radial screws, flush with the skin: 4 into the bosses on tray disc 1 (x 39.8), 4 into the bosses on the rear disc (x 122.0) (z +-3, through each half)

parts.name: pod_cap_L
parts.note: Printed pod cap Ø10 x 1.5 on the coupler end inside the arm head counterbore; the M3 x 8 screw goes through it into the coupler; it overlaps the head so the pod cannot walk off

parts.name: coupler_L_screw
parts.note: M3 x 8 through the pod cap into the coupler end (turns with it)

parts.name: pod_cap_R
parts.note: Printed pod cap Ø10 x 1.5 on the coupler end inside the arm head counterbore; the M3 x 8 screw goes through it into the coupler; it overlaps the head so the pod cannot walk off

parts.name: coupler_R_screw
parts.note: M3 x 8 through the pod cap into the coupler end (turns with it)

parts.name: contacts_front_spring
parts.note: battery spring (B-) on disc 1's rear face, against cell 1's base

parts.name: contacts_mid_strip
parts.note: BM tap: a 0.3 nickel strip disc between cell 1's button and cell 2's base, its tab up to the BMS BM wire (solder it to the tab before the cells go in)

parts.name: contacts_rear_plate
parts.note: rigid contact plate (B+) on the rear disc's front face (launch pushes the cells onto it)

parts.name: jst_loop
parts.note: JST-XH 2-pin power loop socket B2B-XH-A (the shorting plug is the ON switch): header recessed in the left flank seat behind the pivot block (1.2 below the split's centre so the bridle leg passes over the plug's wire loop)

parts.name: jst_charge
parts.note: JST-XH 3-pin charge socket B3B-XH-A, 9.9 wide (B-, BM, B+): header recessed in the right flank seat (opening 10.2, pin pocket 7.0); plug in on the bench only

parts.name: antenna
parts.note: VTX u.FL 5.8 GHz antenna on deck 1 beside the BNO085, along the left flank (PLA is transparent to 5.8 GHz)

parts.name: xiao_antenna
parts.note: XIAO 2.4 GHz FPC antenna (about 20 x 12, NOT measured, folded to 6.5): stuck to the inside of the right flank beside the BNO085

parts.name: capacitor
parts.note: 470 to 1000 uF electrolytic (modelled Ø8 x 12, the worst likely can) standing on the tray's tail key behind the deploy motor, a dab of glue; leads to the MP1584 5 V output (long leg to OUT+)

parts.name: ballast
parts.note: 14.6 g of lead/tungsten putty (Harry's ballast putty, 1.6 cm3 at 9 g/cm3) in the nose: pressed in from the back through the spigot, front first, round and under the camera tube up to the retaining collar at x 13.2, before the nose goes on. It moves the centre of mass forward for flight (pitch and yaw)
